youtube.description: 第13天上午，吳校長帶兩個校警穿過人群，要抓她「毀損校產」；林導把直播鏡頭一轉，校長在十萬人面前退了一步。她說擦的是沈家的泥，校長改口說碑要校董會說了算，她答：那就請校董會的人自己來看。停車場的黑轎車裡，何啟盛一通電話——直播被檢舉，十萬人的畫面一下子全黑。她把黑掉的手機舉到眼前翻來翻去：「剛才十萬個人，怎麼一下子都不見了？」第一次知道什麼叫檢舉；校長趁勢請她出去。傍晚18:30，學校工友把退學通知送到老宅，林美鳳笑著簽收、轉手交給小滿；建業看過直播，要把保母趕走，林美鳳說不急：交屋那天，她跟這屋子一起走。夜裡知遠蹲在祠堂門口塞給她一杯熱豆漿；21:45小滿拿著退學通知走進祠堂，跪在燈前：「姐，我不念了。」

data.prompt: On the stone steps of the ancestral hall of the old Shen house on a cold night, looking out toward the courtyard: Shen Zhiyuan in his dark charcoal overcoat crouches, the veranda lantern light on his face; behind him only the dark courtyard night and the glowing paper lanterns. He is the only person in the frame. He smiles briefly, showing one canine tooth, and speaks a Mandarin line, his lips, jaw and cheeks moving clearly with every syllable, lightly; then he pushes on his knees with both hands and begins to stand; the cut lands mid-rise.

The courtyard in front of the ancestral hall of the old Shen house on a cold night, looking north at the hall, a potted plant beside the steps in the foreground. Two people: Shen Yuetang in her moon-white high-collared shirt sits on the top step, the white paper cup in her right hand; Shen Xiaoman in her light grey hoodie climbs up from the lower left, a sheet of paper folded once in her right hand with its blank side out, her eyes red, not smiling. Yuetang looks down at the cup and the corner of her mouth twitches into a faint smile; Xiaoman, head down, climbs the steps and walks past her into the hall; Yuetang's smile fades, she rises slowly and steadily and follows her to just inside the threshold. Both mouths stay closed.
data.motion: The girl climbs the steps past her into the hall; she rises slowly and follows her to the threshold.

lines.speaker: xiaoman
lines.text: 姐，我不念了。退學就退學，我不想再去了。

data.prompt: Inside the ancestral hall of the old Shen house on a cold night, seen sideways from beside the old medicine cabinet on the left wall looking east, its lamplit bottom-row brass pulls in the foreground. Two people: on screen left the brass oil lamp on the altar; in the middle Shen Xiaoman in her light grey hoodie kneels on the round straw cushion facing the lamp, a sheet of paper folded once in her right hand, tears on her face; on screen right Shen Yuetang in her moon-white high-collared shirt stands just inside the threshold, a half-drunk white paper cup in her right hand, not smiling. The bronze mirror, blurred at the back, reflects nobody. Xiaoman sinks onto the cushion on both knees and looks back at the doorway; Yuetang stands still, the cup frozen in mid-air. Shen Xiaoman speaks a Mandarin line, her lips, jaw and cheeks moving clearly with every syllable, choked with tears, keeping her voice down. Yuetang keeps her mouth closed.
